title: AI-Powered Data Analysis Platform
objective: Build a professional-grade cloud platform for comprehensive data analysis, interactive visualization, and fully automated reporting — eliminating manual analyst overhead.
solution: Architected an in-memory SaaS engine with real-time data processing, AI-driven natural language querying, interactive chart generation, and automated PDF report export. Built with Next.js, Python, Redis, and Gemini AI.
impact: Enabled non-technical users to perform complex data analysis through conversational AI, reducing time-to-insight from hours to minutes.

title: Podcast AI-ETL Pipeline
objective: Automate the ingestion of large video files, converting hours of footage into precise, searchable, and timestamped text using a hybrid local + cloud AI architecture.
solution: Built a Python application leveraging open-source AI speech-to-text models for accurate transcription, with post-processing NLP for speaker identification and topic segmentation.
impact: Reduced manual video processing time by over 80%, enabling rapid content indexing and searchability.

title: Real-Time Country Dashboard
objective: Consolidate fragmented multi-sector data — economy, health, weather — into a centralized real-time dashboard for strategic decision-making across Yemen.
solution: Designed automated ETL pipelines to ingest data from multiple APIs and public sources, with interactive Power BI dashboards featuring drill-down capabilities and row-level security for multi-stakeholder access.
impact: Eliminated reliance on fragmented data sources and enabled faster, evidence-based strategic decisions for programme leadership.

title: Enterprise Database Architecture
objective: Transform unorganized spreadsheets into a scalable, reliable relational database infrastructure for enterprise business operations at TNSC.
solution: Architected a normalized relational database schema with proper entity relationships, data integrity constraints, and migration scripts. Replaced ad-hoc Excel workflows with structured SQL-based data access and reporting.
impact: Established a single source of truth for business operations, dramatically improving data reliability and enabling automated reporting pipelines.
